iteration: 1. HOOK: "Exclusive Trade" label → absurd question about ice cream machines + visual answer + single-word "Tradeable"
2. ESCALATION: Random ordering → mundane-to-cosmic crescendo with "Neither did any of these" callback
3. RHYTHM: Uniform beats → three-act structure (bombardment/silence/breathing) with accelerating card durations
4. VOICE: Flat labels → knife-sentences: "Entertainment is just volatility that hasn't been priced yet" / "Most of them funerals" / "Chaos has a heartbeat"
5. CLARITY: Vague "dark pools" → explicit sealed bets, parimutuel, self-liquidity
6. VISUAL: Generic screenshots → price tickers overlaying data sources, red inverted cards, 8→400k counter
7. CLOSING: Generic CTA → "The world already generates the data. We just added a price."
Reverted changes (5): more direct closing (lost tenderness), subliminal logo frame (gimmicky), train paradox (too clever), "you already know who wins" (presumptuous)
NOTE: Self-scored evaluations are inherently generous. A 10.0 from the same agent that wrote the changes should be discounted. The script improved materially — the magnitude is the suspect variable.
